Experience programming in Python, through coursework, internships, projects or professional work
Knowledge of data structures, algorithms and software testing
Familiarity with shell scripting in bash or PowerShell on Linux and Windows
Hands-on experience using AI coding assistants or agents, including reviewing and testing the code they generate
Experience with Git version control, such as branching and merging

Experience with C, embedded systems or microcontroller programming
Experience with compilers, parsers or static analysis tools, such as libclang or tree-sitter
Experience extending AI agents with custom tools, MCP servers or agent SDKs
Internship, co-op or work experience in developer tools, build systems or CI/CD pipelines
Background in statistics, experiment design or machine learning evaluation
Background in optics, photonics or digital communications

With more than 25,000 associates, we innovate fearlessly, champion progress, and act swiftly to impact global eye health. This role is part of Alcon's Supply Chain Planning Center of Excellence, a team delivering digital capabilities that enable and improve supply chain planning processes. The broader Planning Digital Enablement capability combines reusable data, integration, automation, analytics, and Decision Intelligence solutions to support trusted planning signals, faster decisions, reduced planner effort, and scalable digital capabilities.

The Associate, Software Engineering (Data Automation & Decision Intelligence) will play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining data, automation, analytics, and decision-support solutions for global supply chain planning. The role will develop reusable data pipelines and automated workflows while applying analytics, business rules, and predictive techniques to create decision signals, prioritize exceptions, and support planner recommendations and actions.

Working with supply chain business partners and technology teams, the associate will help translate planning opportunities into scalable technical solutions that improve data reliability, planning productivity, decision speed, and operational outcomes.

The position is based at our Main Office in Fort Worth, TX.

In this role, a typical day will include:

Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, ETL/ELT workflows, and reusable data products using SQL, Python, Alteryx, AWS Glue, and related technologies to integrate, transform, validate, and automate supply chain planning data.
Develop scalable automation and decision-support solutions that reduce manual planner effort, improve process consistency, prioritize material exceptions, and enable users to move from data and insights to decisions and actions.
Apply analytics, statistical methods, and predictive techniques, with opportunities to develop capabilities in machine learning, simulation, and optimization, to support supply chain challenges such as demand forecasting, supply and capacity planning, inventory optimization, risk identification, and logistics.
Develop decision signals, exception logic, scoring and prioritization methods, and recommendation logic that help planners identify risks and opportunities and focus on the highest-value actions.
Build dashboards, visualizations, and planner-facing decision experiences that communicate insights, explain key drivers and recommendations, and support effective decision-making.
Support human-in-the-loop decision workflows by connecting analytical recommendations with planner review, approval or override, action, and feedback.
Collaborate with supply chain business partners and technology teams to translate planning opportunities into data requirements, business rules, analytical logic, technical solutions, and acceptance criteria.
Test, validate, and monitor data, automation, analytical models, and decision-support solutions using appropriate data-quality controls, performance measures, back-testing, scenario analysis, and user validation.
Contribute to reusable engineering practices including code reviews, version control, documentation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and knowledge sharing.
Support integrations across enterprise planning and data platforms and develop solutions that can be reused across demand, supply, inventory, capacity, and logistics planning use cases.
All associates must adhere to applicable GxP regulations, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), documentation, quality-control, training, and regulatory requirements.

High School Diploma or equivalent
The ability to fluently read, write, understand, and communicate in English
3 years of Relevant Experience
Work hours: 1st Shift; Monday – Friday; 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CST
Location: Onsite Fort Worth, TX

Strong working knowledge of SQL and Python, including experience transforming, analyzing, and validating datasets using pandas, NumPy, or similar libraries.
Experience with data integration, ETL/ELT, or workflow automation technologies such as Alteryx, AWS Glue, APIs, data lakes, data warehouses, or comparable platforms.
Experience with data visualization and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Quick Sight, or comparable technologies.
Familiarity with statistical analysis and predictive modeling, with interest or experience in areas such as machine learning, forecasting, optimization, simulation, anomaly detection, or other analytical techniques.
Interest or experience in Decision Intelligence, decision-support solutions, exception management, recommendation logic, or human-in-the-loop workflows, including translating analytical outputs into prioritized decisions and actions.
Knowledge of or interest in supply chain planning, including demand, supply, inventory, capacity, manufacturing, S&OP/IBP, or logistics processes.
Exposure to enterprise supply chain and planning technologies such as SAP IBP, SAP OBP, SAP ECC/S/4HANA, Aera Decision Cloud, SAP Datasphere, ForeSight, or comparable platforms is preferred.
Ability to translate business problems into data requirements, business rules, analytical logic, technical requirements, and measurable outcomes, and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
Familiarity with software-engineering practices, including Git/version control, code review, testing, documentation, deployment, and solution monitoring.

Collaborate with teammates to share standard processes and learnings as work evolves!
See your career like never before with focused growth and development opportunities

added.title: Software Engineer - Humanoid Sim-to-Real
added.description:
Apptronik is a human-centered robotics company developing AI-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond.

We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better.

JOB SUMMARY

The Software Engineer - Humanoid Sim-to-Real is a core contributor to how our humanoid robots carry behavior from simulation onto hardware. This role is responsible for closing the gap between simulated and real robot behavior through simulation development, hardware experimentation, and system identification.

This role will bridge the gap between simulation and physical hardware. Working closely with the simulation, controls, learning, and hardware teams, this engineer will turn measured robot behavior into accurate models of dynamics, kinematics, contact, and actuation that enable high-performance locomotion and manipulation.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

Build and maintain simulation infrastructure that supports humanoid locomotion and manipulation
Implement and validate models of rigid-body dynamics, kinematics, contact, and actuators, including electromechanical effects where relevant.
Design and run paired hardware and simulation experiments to characterize system behavior and reduce sim-to-real discrepancies.
Apply system identification methods to estimate and validate model parameters from experimental data.
Use classical controls and frequency-domain tools to analyze performance, including bandwidth, stability, and response.
Develop reproducible Python and C++ tooling for experiment automation, data analysis, and model verification.
Collaborate with the simulation, controls, learning, and hardware teams to find root causes and improve performance on the robot.
Establish repeatable best practices for running experiments and validating models against hardware.

SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS

Technical Skills (Must-Have)

Core Expertise:
Deep expertise in at least one of controls, system identification, simulation, robot modeling, or reinforcement learning, with working knowledge across the others.
Hardware-to-Simulation:
Experience connecting hardware data to simulation through experimental modeling or system identification.
Software Engineering:
Proficiency in Python (NumPy, PyTorch) and/or C++ (Eigen), and experience with at least one modern simulator such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim/Lab, or Brax.
Experimental Design:
Ability to design structured experiments and reason from noisy data to physical explanations.
Controls Fundamentals:
Familiarity with classical control concepts and dynamic system response.
Code Quality:
A track record of shipping maintainable code with Git in fast-moving R&D environments.

Good to Have

Humanoid or Legged Robots:
Experience working with humanoid or legged robot hardware.
Reinforcement Learning:
Experience training, tuning, or deploying RL policies.
Contact & Actuator Modeling:
Background in contact modeling, actuator characterization, or sim-to-real transfer.
Lab Instrumentation:
Hands-on experience with lab instrumentation and hardware validation workflows.
Infrastructure:
Experience with Docker and GPU or cloud-based development.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE

A BS with 3-5 years of relevant experience, or an MS with 1-3 years of relevant experience, or a PhD, in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
A track record of validating simulation models against physical hardware.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times
Vision to read printed materials and a computer screen
Hearing and speech to communicate
This is a direct hire. Please, no outside Agency solicitations.

added.title: Software Engineer, Voices
added.description:
About Cartesia

Our mission is to architect AI that learns from and interacts with the world like humans do.

We're pioneering the model architectures that will make this possible. Our founding team met as PhDs at the Stanford AI Lab, where we invented State Space Models or SSMs, a new primitive for training efficient, large-scale foundation models. Our team combines deep expertise in model innovation and systems engineering paired with a design-minded product engineering team to build and ship cutting edge models and experiences.

We're funded by leading investors at Index Ventures and Lightspeed Venture Partners, along with Factory, Conviction, A Star, General Catalyst, SV Angel, Databricks and others. We're fortunate to have the support of many amazing advisors, and 90+ angels across many industries, including the world's foremost experts in AI.

About The Role

Cartesia builds real-time multimodal intelligence: fast, state-of-the-art voice models and the products that make them useful. We started as a research lab, pioneered the state space model architecture, and now we're bringing that research to customers through intuitive tools for creating, testing, and shipping with voice.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join our Voices team. Every conversation powered by Cartesia starts with a voice. The Voices team builds how customers find, clone, and design voices that sound right for their product, in any language.

The work reaches across the company. You’ll work closely with:

Research: Turn new model capabilities into product features, such as turning voices multilingual and steering voices to match the ideal profile.
Platform and infra: Serve every voice reliably at the scale of our API traffic.
On-prem: Build adaptable interfaces and systems so that voices are available and compatible in a variety of settings and hardware.
Customer-facing teams: Help every customer get a great voice on their own.

Your Impact

Build polished product experiences for finding, cloning, and designing voices, from the first listen to a voice running in production.
Design the APIs developers build on, so every capability is as easy to use in code as it is in the product.
Turn early research into features customers use every day, like voice cloning, localization, and voice design.
Build the backend systems that train, store, and serve custom voices at scale, in the cloud and on-prem.
Raise the quality bar for every voice we launch, with internal tools, automated evaluations, and analytics that show how voices sound and perform.

What You Bring

3+ years of experience building and operating customer-facing software in production, ideally at a high-growth startup, including owning systems that serve high traffic reliably. We care more about what you’ve shipped and kept running at scale than strict years of experience.
Strong product instincts: you think in customer outcomes, usability, quality, and developer experience, and you have opinions on what to build and why.
Full-stack range and the ability to own a product surface across frontend, backend, APIs, data, and operational concerns.
Fluent use of coding agents and a habit of keeping pace with the frontier.
Clear communication with technical and non-technical audiences, strong cross-functional partnership, and a sharp presence in product and design reviews.

Nice-To-Haves

Experience building developer tools, creative tools, playgrounds, or API-adjacent products.
Experience building AI-powered products and translating model capabilities, limitations, and quality tradeoffs into understandable user experiences.
Strong frontend craft with React and TypeScript, including polished, highly interactive workflows.
Experience with audio, media, real-time systems, product analytics, experimentation, or evaluation infrastructure.
Working familiarity with deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting services on Kubernetes, especially in multi-cluster setups

Note: Cartesia participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with Form I-9 information to confirm employment eligibility after hire.

More Details

🏢 In-office policy:
We’re an in-person team based out of offices in 🇺🇸 San Francisco, 🇬🇧 London and 🇮🇳 Bangalore. We love being in the office, hanging out together, and learning from each other every day.

At EMCORE LLC, we're committed to attracting and nurturing diverse, high-performing talent who are passionate about their work. Our employees share a common purpose-supporting our Customers' missions while pursuing their own professional growth. We foster an inclusive and engaging workplace culture where innovation, collaboration, and work-life balance thrive. Core to our values is a steadfast commitment to excellence, community engagement, and integrity in everything we do.

About EMCORE

EMCORE LLC is a leading independent provider of advanced inertial navigation solutions for the aerospace, defense, commercial, and industrial sectors. As pioneers in fiber optic gyros and Quartz MEMS technologies, we drive innovation across a wide range of navigation applications.

Position Summary:

EMCORE is seeking a Test/Software Engineer
for the Research & Design (R&D) Engineering team who is responsible for ensuring that testing of EMCORE's inertial sensors - accelerometers, gyroscopes, and inertial measurement units (IMUs) - is performed with appropriate engineering rigor. This role supports R&D Engineering and Operations functions to develop and maintain the software, statistical methods, data systems, and infrastructure that support testing of EMCORE's sensor product lines and serves as a key technical resource for design engineering, production, and Customers on questions of sensor test data, performance, and configuration. The ideal candidate will bring leadership, technical expertise, and the ability to translate Customer requirements into executable actions. This in-office role is based at the Quartz MEMS (QMEMS) facility in Concord, CA. Occasional travel (<10%) to Customers, suppliers, or other EMCORE facilities may be required.

Key Responsibilities:

Production Test Software Development & Support

Develop, enhance, and maintain in-house production test and post-processing software supporting inertial sensor test stations, using C#, VB.NET, and/or Python.
Diagnose and resolve software and test-station configuration issues that cause test aborts or invalid post-processing results, including issues affecting multiple stations.
Maintain and enhance internal engineering/test utilities in response to requests from Customers and team members.
Serve as a technical point of contact for production test issues, including aborted test runs, marginal failures, and data anomalies, providing root-cause analysis and corrective guidance to operators.
Support disposition of Corrective Action Reports (CARs) and communicate technical findings to internal stakeholders and Customers.

Data Analysis & Statistical Support

Query and analyze production test data to characterize sensor performance, including bias, scale factor, and stability.
Perform statistical analysis to support engineering recommendations, including proposed changes to specification limits, with supporting data visualizations and presentations to stakeholders.
Correlate data across multiple databases and test systems to answer engineering and production questions.

Submit and track engineering Change Requests/Notices (CR/CN) through the product lifecycle management (PLM) system.
Track and manage software changes through source control in coordination with released requirements changes.
Write and maintain test procedures, technical specifications, and verification/summary test reports.
Generate compliance and Customer-facing documentation.

Hardware Development and Qualification Testing Support

Review data from Design Validation Testing (DVT) and Qualification Testing to assess compliance against internal product requirements and Customer specifications.
Support project planning and proposal efforts by estimating resources, timelines, and costs.
Develop and present materials for design reviews and test readiness reviews.

Database & Records Management

Maintain accuracy of sensor build, test, and inventory records across production databases, including Work in Process (WIP) tracking.
Support data integrity between engineering, production, and configuration databases.

Cross-Functional & Customer Technical Support

Respond to technical inquiries from design engineers, production, and Customers regarding sensor specifications, calibration, and output characteristics.
Support special data requests and historical research for design and production engineering.
Support Technical Interchange Meetings (TIMs) with Customers.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Minimum of five (5) years experience (3 years with Masters) in a test/software engineering role supporting the production of electromechanical, sensor, or similarly regulated/high-reliability hardware products.
Foundational understanding of verification/validation test approaches for electromechanical devices.
Proficiency in C# and/or VB.NET; working knowledge of Python and SQL.
Experience with relational databases and query tools (e.g., SQL Server Management Studio).
Familiarity with statistical analysis tools and methods (e.g., JMP or equivalent) applied to engineering or test data.
Understanding of Work in Process (WIP) tracking, data modeling, and production database structures.
Ability to balance rigorous verification testing against schedule and business constraints.
Demonstrated critical thinking skills with the ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to both give and receive constructive feedback in a highly collaborative environment.

Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience with inertial sensors or systems (e.g., accelerometers, gyroscopes, IMUs), or related precision electromechanical products.

About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

Vercel started as the home for frontends. The Languages and Runtimes team is making it the home for the rest of the application: APIs, background workers, AI agents, and the services that connect them. This past year we took Python on Vercel to general availability, launched Vercel Services so frontends and backends deploy together as one project, and, alongside our Compute team, helped bring always-on background workers to the platform.

Our work spans the path from source code to a running process: tooling that understands an application’s structure, packages its dependencies, and runs it on Vercel, plus language runtimes, SDKs, private service-to-service communication, and production observability. Much of it is making existing applications run efficiently without asking developers to rework them, whether that means taming large dependency sets, cutting cold starts, precompiling Python bytecode at build time, or serving a framework’s static assets straight from the CDN.

Next, we’re bringing first-class support to Go and Rust, from builds and packaging to runtime integration and SDKs, and improving observability so developers can see how their services connect and where requests spend their time. You’ll work across these layers, following problems from a developer’s application down to how it builds and executes.

What You Will Do:

Build and maintain backend services and infrastructure using Python and Rust.
Improve serverless Python execution, including dependency management, runtime behavior, startup performance, and resource efficiency.
Design distributed systems that support reliable deployment and execution of customer applications and AI workloads.
Develop cloud infrastructure and deployment automation using Infrastructure as Code.
Investigate performance bottlenecks and production issues across services, runtimes, and infrastructure.
Partner with engineering and product teams to turn developer needs into reliable platform capabilities.
Own the services you ship, including monitoring, incident response, and participation in an on-call rotation.

About You:

Experience shipping and operating backend software in production, with strong Python skills and practical experience with Rust.
Hands-on experience with cloud infrastructure, such as AWS, and an understanding of compute, networking, storage, and service deployment.
Familiarity with distributed systems, concurrency, asynchronous execution, and the tradeoffs involved in building reliable services.
Experience with containers, CI/CD, and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

Overview

As a Senior Backend Engineer on the Sales Engineering team, you will be a core contributor to the systems that power our end-to-end customer vehicle purchase journey. From trade-in and vehicle configuration through finance, leasing, and delivery — you will build reliable, well-crafted backend services and work hands-on with the third-party integrations that bring those capabilities to life.

You will collaborate closely with engineers, product managers, and external partners to ship features that directly impact how customers experience buying a vehicle. You'll take ownership of meaningful pieces of the stack, contribute to technical decisions within your team, and grow your scope over time.

This role is ideal for an engineer who writes thoughtful, production-quality code, takes pride in building things that work reliably, and wants to deepen their experience in a complex, high-stakes transactional domain.

What You’ll Do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Build and maintain backend services across the customer purchase journey — writing clean, well-tested, production-quality code that your teammates can rely on and build upon.
Design and implement APIs, data models, and service logic that are correct, performant, and easy to evolve as requirements change.
Integrate with third-party providers - valuation services, lender platforms, logistics APIs, and factory systems - building integration layers that are reliable and well-abstracted.
Apply sound engineering patterns to the challenges of distributed systems: error handling, retries, idempotency, and observability - both within our own services and across external dependencies.
Take end-to-end ownership of features: from scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and monitoring in production.
Participate actively in code and design reviews: sharing knowledge, catching issues early, and helping maintain a high engineering bar across the team.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and partner teams to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet real user needs.
Contribute to improving team practices: documentation, testing standards, on-call processes, and the day-to-day reliability of the systems you own.
Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to increase your own velocity and share effective practices with teammates.

added.title: Founding Software Engineer, Platform & Infrastructure for DeepFrame
added.description:
What DeepFrame is:

DeepFrame is InfiniMind's video intelligence platform. Enterprises point it at video they already have - broadcast programming, in-store footage, operations video - and get evidence-backed answers: search across thousands of hours, questions answered with timestamped clips, and rulebook reviews that turn a company's own standards into findings with severity and proof.

We are not an AI wrapper. We build the full stack ourselves: our own video-understanding foundation models, ingestion and indexing across visual, speech, on-screen text, and time, a search engine, and agents on top. It runs as SaaS or single-tenant in the customer's own AWS account, with on-prem options for footage that cannot leave the building.

DeepFrame has paying enterprise customers in Japan in broadcasting and retail. You will be the first engineer on the ground in the US, working with a US GTM lead hired in parallel and with our core engineering and research team in Tokyo.

What this role really is:

An infrastructure and platform engineer with a feel for AI - not an "AI engineer" who wraps someone else's API. Roughly:
~75% building the platform - GPU inference and video-processing infrastructure, ingestion and indexing pipelines, search and serving, performance and cost at scale, shipped into the shared DeepFrame codebase with the Tokyo team
~25% with customers - joining technical meetings with the GTM lead, answering integration and security questions, and getting pilots running on the customer's own video

When a US customer needs something, you build it properly in the core product, not as a one-off fork.

How the US team works:

You and the US founding GTM lead are DeepFrame's US team. They lead the customer conversation; you join technical discovery and make sure what we commit to can be built and run.
Daily with the CTO on the technical side - architecture, priorities, code review, and how US needs land in the core product with the Tokyo engineering team
Daily with the CEO on the business side - which customers and pilots matter most, and what we commit to
A short daily sync across San Francisco and Tokyo (late afternoon Pacific / morning Japan), plus a weekly US pipeline and pilot review
You report to the CEO. The CTO owns architecture, technical direction, and code review; when commercial and technical priorities conflict, the CEO decides what we commit to a customer, with the CTO owning technical feasibility

What you will do:

Build and run GPU infrastructure for video understanding on AWS: model serving, batching, scheduling, and cost per video-hour
Scale ingestion and indexing pipelines for large video libraries: decoding, transcoding, frame, audio, and on-screen text processing, embeddings
Work on the search and retrieval layer and the APIs customers integrate with
Build connectors to where US customers keep video (S3, media asset management systems, camera exports) and to where they want results (APIs, webhooks)
Deploy for enterprise customers - SaaS, single-tenant in their AWS account, or on-prem - and own reliability and observability
Join customer technical meetings with the GTM lead and turn what you hear into product requirements

Your first 90 days:

Day 30
- DeepFrame running in a test AWS environment. First production change merged. A measured view of where our GPU and pipeline costs go.
Day 60
- One infrastructure improvement owned end to end (throughput, cost, or reliability). Pilot environment ready for the first US customer.
Day 90
- Technical owner of the first US pilot, from data access through first results review. At least one US-driven feature or connector shipped to the core product.

Must Haves:

5+ years building production infrastructure or backend platforms, with real distributed-systems depth
Strong Python, plus a systems language (Go, Rust, or C++)
GPU workloads in production - you have run and optimized model inference or ML pipelines on cloud GPUs (CUDA, TensorRT, Triton, or similar); AWS preferred; containers and Kubernetes
Large data or media pipelines - you have moved and processed a lot of data reliably and cheaply
Can explain technical tradeoffs to a customer's engineers in a meeting
Authorized to work in the United States by your start date; we do not sponsor visas for this role
Based in the Bay Area, in person in San Francisco at least 3 days a week, and able to travel to customers occasionally

Strong pluses:

Video and media processing (ffmpeg, codecs, GStreamer, NVIDIA DeepStream / NVDEC)
Search infrastructure: vector databases, retrieval, and ranking at scale
ML systems: serving foundation models, evaluation pipelines
Enterprise deployment: VPC / on-prem installs, SSO, security reviews
Worked with a team across time zones, especially Japan; working proficiency in Japanese is a plus, not required

Job Description

Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) ensure the smooth operation of production systems by combining engineering principles, operational discipline, and automation within the P&G codebase and operating environments. SREs are implementing best practices for availability, reliability, and scalability. They are responsible for maintaining and automating monitoring, alerting to proactively identify and resolve potential incidents and drive continuous improvement. SRE defines and manages service level objectives (SLOs), service level indicators (SLIs), service level agreements (SLAs) and ensures those are met or exceeded.

As a Site Reliability Engineer focused on Identity & Access Management, you will be responsible for maintaining, monitoring, supporting, and upgrading processes and systems for one or multiple Digital Products with quality and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

Incident Management and Monitoring: Monitor system alerts and respond promptly to incidents, ensuring that Service Level Agreements (SLAs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) are met or exceeded. Performing Root Cause Analysis and creating Postmortems to improve incident response time and ensure consistent stability of the application.
Automation and Process Improvement: Automate repetitive tasks, implement and maintain monitoring and logging systems, drive continuous improvements to prevent future incidents, including defining standards for processes.
Guidance and Collaboration: Provide expert guidance to Stakeholders (Product, Platform, and Software Engineering teams) in relation to supportability, scalability, and efficiency with products and tools in the organization's portfolio.
Infrastructure Management: Administer platform infrastructure, oversee change management procedures, contributing to product roadmap creation and defining strategies for critical products. Oversee vendor management, contribute to product roadmap creation, and define strategies for digital products to enhance service delivery. Represent Operations into PoC and Pilots. Ensure processes and tools are ready by Day 1 of Go Live. Drive observability implementations with monitoring and metrics, incident responses, feedback loops, documentation and knowledge sharing

Experience in Ping Authentication products (Ping ID, Ping Federate, Ping Radius) and PAM products (Centrify) is a big plus.

The Company

PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Summary:

PayPal Marketing Technology team is dedicated to creating a best-in-class platform. We are looking for highly talented, professional, and motivated engineers to join our team. As a Senior Data Engineer on our Marketing Technology Platform, you will be at the forefront of designing and developing scalable data pipelines and data services on GCP (BigQuery, Bigtable) using Python, Kafka, and SQL.

You will take part in all facets of data pipeline development, including design, coding, instrumentation, security, testing, and overseeing production releases, delivering new features, enhancements, and fixes for the data platform that powers MarTech.

We are building an AI-native engineering team. You will design and deliver agentic use cases, leveraging Google Gemini, Claude, and other AI platforms, and use AI-assisted tooling across the development lifecycle.

Job Description:

Essential Responsibilities:

Lead the design and development of complex data pipelines for data collection and processing.
Develop and maintain advanced data storage solutions.
Ensure data quality and consistency through sophisticated validation and cleansing processes.
Implement advanced data transformation techniques to prepare data for analysis.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements and provide innovative solutions.
Optimize data engineering processes for performance, scalability, and reliability.

Minimum Qualifications:

3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:

Meet our team

At PayPal Marketing Technology Platform, we are a supportive, forward-thinking community of customer-centric technologists. We celebrate our successes, learn from our challenges, and always keep pushing forward. Whether we're brainstorming the next big feature, tackling complex technical challenges, or sharing insights from our latest project, there's a shared sense of purpose and excitement for what we're building. Together, we share a common goal: to build seamless, secure, and scalable solutions that empower individuals and businesses around the globe.

Your way to impact

Your work will directly contribute to PayPal's overarching mission of revolutionizing customer engagement globally. By building, enhancing, and scaling the data pipelines and data services that underpin our marketing technology experiences, you will be a key player in enabling seamless and innovative ways of engaging our customers worldwide. Your efforts in developing high-quality, secure, and performant data solutions will improve customer experiences and drive the inclusion and flexibility that are critical in today's digital economy. Your role goes beyond coding; it's about making a tangible impact on the lives of millions.

In your day-to-day role you will

Design and build highly scalable, high-throughput data pipelines in GCP using BigQuery and Bigtable, primarily batch with streaming integrations via Kafka.
Write and maintain production-grade pipelines in Python and advanced SQL.
Own BigQuery-backed datasets and pipelines that support complex Marketing use cases, with ingress and egress at scale.
Build agentic services end to end on top of our data and pipelines, covering data access, orchestration, guardrails, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, leveraging Google Gemini, Claude, and other AI platforms.
Use AI-native development practices to accelerate design, coding, testing, and operations.
Design data models and access patterns that are adaptable to evolving business needs.
Optimize BigQuery performance, cost, and reliability using partitioning, clustering, and query tuning.
Build and operate real-time and near-real-time pipelines using Pub/Sub, batch or streaming frameworks, and Java services.
Model data and design schemas across OLTP and OLAP systems, balancing performance, cost, and usability.
Schedule and orchestrate jobs using Airflow and UC4.
Instrument pipelines for monitoring, data quality, and alerting, and implement data lineage so that data is observable and trustworthy.
Independently own multiple data features end to end, proposing innovative solutions for new and existing functionality.
Deliver complete solutions across all phases of the SDLC: design, implementation, testing, delivery, and operations.
Operate with little day-to-day supervision, making sound technical decisions grounded in internal conventions and industry best practices.
Troubleshoot pipeline and data issues and drive root-cause fixes.
Advise management on project-level issues and risks.
Actively participate in design and code reviews, giving and incorporating constructive feedback.
Guide junior engineers and share your knowledge to help new team members onboard quickly.

What do you need to bring

A bachelor's degree in computer science or an equivalent combination of technical education and work experience.
6+ years of data engineering experience, with expertise in ETL/ELT: extracting, transforming, and loading data from varied sources using advanced SQL and Python.
An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience building agentic services end to end using Google Gemini, Claude, and other LLM platforms and agent frameworks.
Strong data fundamentals: data warehouses, data marts, data lakes, data modeling, and schema design.
Fluency with both OLTP and OLAP systems and the trade-offs between them.
Hands-on experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems such as Kafka or Pulsar, and streaming integrations.
Hands-on experience with databases, both SQL and NoSQL.
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
Experience designing and building highly scalable data pipelines that handle very high data volumes in GCP (BigQuery, Bigtable).
4+ years of hands-on experience on Google Cloud Platform, particularly BigQuery and Pub/Sub.
Experience with workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow or UC4.
Experience with pipeline instrumentation, data quality, and data lineage.
Experience implementing CI/CD, automated testing, and observability to improve delivery quality and operational resilience, with fluency in Git and collaborative development workflows.
Experience using Atlassian JIRA, ServiceNow, and Confluence.
Experience delivering projects using Agile methodology.

PayPal
